evidence: The chemical state at the HfO2/Si interface has been measured using X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS). High-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM) was used to determine a film thickness, and to investigate the interface morphologies and structures of the film. The electrical properties such as hysteresis, EOT, and fixed oxide charge density were measured by capacitance-voltage (C-V) measured by a Keithley 590 C-V analyzer.
